speaker: character
text: I read your proposal. Thanks, but no. The one-to-one sessions work, and the parents trust them.

speaker: candidate
text: Okay, never mind. It was just an idea.

speaker: character
text: What makes you so sure it works better?

speaker: candidate
text: I just know it works. It worked for me when I was little.

speaker: character
text: Feelings aren't enough. Last year someone changed the sessions on a hunch, and I spent a month apologising to parents.

speaker: candidate
text: Then there's no point trying. Okay, you win.

speaker: character
text: Say we tried it. What could go wrong, and who would pay for it?

speaker: candidate
text: I don't see any risks. It'll be fine.

speaker: character
text: The others already have full Saturdays. Who's going to run this?

speaker: candidate
text: You're the coordinator. That's your job, not mine.

speaker: character
text: Alright. One trial. But I want to know exactly how it would work.

speaker: candidate
text: No point testing. Let's switch all sessions at once.

speaker: character
text: Two pupils came out confused, and a mother called me. So. What now?

speaker: candidate
text: I knew it wouldn't work. Let's cancel the trial.
